draft.emotion: contented and satisfied after a good meal, feeling comfortably heavy
notes: Irregular 르 adjective: conjugates as 배불러요 in the present tense.
Used only for feeling full from food, not for containers (use 가득 차다). Opposite: 배고프다 ('hungry').

senses.definition: Having eaten enough or too much food; no longer hungry.
